quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open
why: The judge decides the Acts 2:30 collision by checking whether any single verse names whose body is the channel, and answers the pressed rows verse by verse (Matthew 1:16, Galatians 4:4, Genesis 46:26, Hebrews 7:9-10) instead of weighing the challenger's chain against the defender's chain by footing, which is the stating-verse test K-C forbids.
